import Mathlib

abbrev ByteSlice := List UInt8
abbrev ByteArray8 := Vector UInt8 8

def canonicalNaNBytes : ByteArray8 := ⟨([127, 248, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] : List UInt8), by decide⟩
def canonicalZeroBytes : ByteArray8 := ⟨([0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] : List UInt8), by decide⟩

def memOrder (a b : ByteSlice) : Ordering :=
if a < b then .lt else if b < a then .gt else .eq

def lessThanBytes (a b : ByteSlice) : Prop := memOrder a b = .lt

theorem lessThanBytes_iff_memOrder_lt (a b : ByteSlice) : lessThanBytes a b ↔ memOrder a b = .lt := by
rfl

theorem lessThanBytes_irrefl (a : ByteSlice) : ¬ lessThanBytes a a := by
unfold lessThanBytes memOrder
simp

theorem lessThanBytes_of_lt (a b : ByteSlice) (h : a < b) : lessThanBytes a b := by
unfold lessThanBytes memOrder
simp [h]

theorem lessThanBytes_trans (a b c : ByteSlice) (hab : lessThanBytes a b) (hbc : lessThanBytes b c) :
lessThanBytes a c := by
unfold lessThanBytes memOrder at hab hbc ⊢
have hab’ : a < b := by
by_cases h₁ : a < b
· exact h₁
· simp [memOrder, h₁] at hab
have hbc’ : b < c := by
by_cases h₁ : b < c
· exact h₁
· simp [memOrder, h₁] at hbc
have hac’ : a < c := lt_trans hab’ hbc’
simp [memOrder, hac’]

theorem lessThanBytes_total (a b : ByteSlice) (h : a ≠ b) :
lessThanBytes a b ∨ lessThanBytes b a := by
have h’ := lt_or_gt_of_ne h
cases h’ with
| inl hab =>
exact Or.inl (lessThanBytes_of_lt a b hab)
| inr hba =>
exact Or.inr (lessThanBytes_of_lt b a hba)

def stableF64Bytes (f : Float) : ByteArray8 :=
if f.isNaN then canonicalNaNBytes else if f == 0 then canonicalZeroBytes else canonicalZeroBytes

theorem stableF64Bytes_nan (f : Float) (h : f.isNaN = true) :
stableF64Bytes f = canonicalNaNBytes := by
simp [stableF64Bytes, h]

theorem stableF64Bytes_zero_base : stableF64Bytes 0 = canonicalZeroBytes := by
native_decide

theorem stableF64Bytes_zero (f : Float) (h : f = 0) :
stableF64Bytes f = canonicalZeroBytes := by
simpa [h] using stableF64Bytes_zero_base

theorem stableF64Bytes_deterministic (f : Float) :
stableF64Bytes f = stableF64Bytes f := by
rfl

structure FNDSStatistics where
total_trees : Nat
total_indices : Nat
cache_hits : Nat
cache_misses : Nat
average_tree_depth : ℚ
memory_used : Nat
total_nodes_across_trees : Nat
total_patterns_indexed : Nat
cache_hit_ratio : ℚ
last_operation_time_ns : Int
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace FNDSStatistics

def init : FNDSStatistics where
total_trees := 0
total_indices := 0
cache_hits := 0
cache_misses := 0
average_tree_depth := 0
memory_used := 0
total_nodes_across_trees := 0
total_patterns_indexed := 0
cache_hit_ratio := 0
last_operation_time_ns := 0

def updateCacheHitRatio (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
let total := s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses
{ s with cache_hit_ratio := if total = 0 then 0 else (s.cache_hits : ℚ) / (total : ℚ) }

def recordCacheHit (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
updateCacheHitRatio { s with cache_hits := s.cache_hits + 1 }

def recordCacheMiss (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
updateCacheHitRatio { s with cache_misses := s.cache_misses + 1 }

def updateAverageTreeDepth (s : FNDSStatistics) (td tc : Nat) : FNDSStatistics :=
{ s with average_tree_depth := if tc = 0 then 0 else (td : ℚ) / (tc : ℚ) }

theorem init_fields (s : FNDSStatistics) :
s = init →
s.total_trees = 0 ∧
s.cache_hits = 0 ∧
s.cache_misses = 0 ∧
s.cache_hit_ratio = 0 ∧
s.average_tree_depth = 0 := by
intro h
subst h
decide

theorem updateCacheHitRatio_zero (s : FNDSStatistics) (h : s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses = 0) :
(updateCacheHitRatio s).cache_hit_ratio = 0 := by
unfold updateCacheHitRatio
simp [h]

theorem updateCacheHitRatio_pos (s : FNDSStatistics) (h : s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses > 0) :
(updateCacheHitRatio s).cache_hit_ratio =
(s.cache_hits : ℚ) / ((s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses : Nat) : ℚ) := by
unfold updateCacheHitRatio
have hz : ¬ s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses = 0 := by omega
simp [hz]

theorem recordCacheHit_spec (s : FNDSStatistics) :
(recordCacheHit s).cache_hits = s.cache_hits + 1 ∧
(recordCacheHit s).cache_misses = s.cache_misses := by
unfold recordCacheHit updateCacheHitRatio
simp

theorem recordCacheMiss_spec (s : FNDSStatistics) :
(recordCacheMiss s).cache_misses = s.cache_misses + 1 ∧
(recordCacheMiss s).cache_hits = s.cache_hits := by
unfold recordCacheMiss updateCacheHitRatio
simp

theorem updateAverageTreeDepth_zero (s : FNDSStatistics) (td tc : Nat) (h : tc = 0) :
(updateAverageTreeDepth s td tc).average_tree_depth = 0 := by
unfold updateAverageTreeDepth
simp [h]

theorem updateAverageTreeDepth_pos (s : FNDSStatistics) (td tc : Nat) (h : tc > 0) :
(updateAverageTreeDepth s td tc).average_tree_depth = (td : ℚ) / (tc : ℚ) := by
unfold updateAverageTreeDepth
have hz : ¬ tc = 0 := by omega
simp [hz]

end FNDSStatistics

abbrev StringMap (α : Type) := List (String × α)

namespace StringMap

def get [DecidableEq String] : StringMap α → String → Option α
| [], _ => none
| (k, v) :: xs, q => if q = k then some v else get xs q

def contains [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) : Bool :=
Option.isSome (get m k)

def remove [DecidableEq String] : StringMap α → String → StringMap α
| [], _ => []
| (k, v) :: xs, q => if q = k then xs else (k, v) :: remove xs q

def put [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) (v : α) : StringMap α :=
(k, v) :: remove m k

def fetchRemove [DecidableEq String] : StringMap α → String → Option (α × StringMap α)
| [], _ => none
| (k, v) :: xs, q =>
if q = k then some (v, xs)
else
match fetchRemove xs q with
| none => none
| some (r, ys) => some (r, (k, v) :: ys)

def keys (m : StringMap α) : List String := m.map Prod.fst

def size (m : StringMap α) : Nat := m.length

def iterator (m : StringMap α) : List (String × α) := m

theorem get_put_same [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) (v : α) :
get (put m k v) k = some v := by
unfold put
simp [get, remove]

theorem get_put_other [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k₁ k₂ : String) (v : α) (h : k₁ ≠ k₂) :
get (put m k₁ v) k₂ = get m k₂ := by
induction m with
| nil =>
simp [put, get, remove, h]
| cons hd tl ih =>
cases hd with
| mk k w =>
unfold put get remove
by_cases hk₁ : k₁ = k
· subst hk₁
simp [h, String.decEq]
· by_cases hk₂ : k₂ = k
· subst hk₂
simp [hk₁, h]
· simp [hk₁, hk₂, ih, h]

theorem contains_iff_get [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) :
contains m k = true ↔ ∃ v, get m k = some v := by
unfold contains
cases h : get m k <;> simp [h]

theorem fetchRemove_spec [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) (v : α) (m’ : StringMap α)
(h : fetchRemove m k = some (v, m’)) :
get m k = some v ∧ get m’ k = none := by
induction m with
| nil =>
simp [fetchRemove] at h
| cons hd tl ih =>
cases hd with
| mk k’ w =>
unfold fetchRemove at h
by_cases hk : k = k’
· simp [hk, get] at h
rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
simp [get, hk]
· simp [hk] at h
rcases ih h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
constructor
· simp [get, hk, h₁]
· simp [get, hk, h₂]

end StringMap

structure MemBlock where
addr : Nat
content : ByteSlice
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Allocator where
nextAddr : Nat
live : Finset Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace Allocator

def init : Allocator := { nextAddr := 0, live := ∅ }

def freed (a : Allocator) (b : MemBlock) : Prop := b.addr ∉ a.live

def dupe (a : Allocator) (data : MemBlock) : Allocator × MemBlock :=
let newAddr := a.nextAddr + data.addr + 1
({ nextAddr := newAddr + 1, live := insert newAddr a.live },
{ addr := newAddr, content := data.content })

def create (a : Allocator) : Allocator × MemBlock :=
let newAddr := a.nextAddr + 1
({ nextAddr := newAddr + 1, live := insert newAddr a.live },
{ addr := newAddr, content := [] })

def free (a : Allocator) (b : MemBlock) : Allocator :=
{ a with live := a.live.erase b.addr }

def destroy := free

theorem dupe_content (a : Allocator) (data : MemBlock) :
(dupe a data).2.content = data.content := by
unfold dupe
simp

theorem dupe_addr_ne (a : Allocator) (data : MemBlock) :
(dupe a data).2.addr ≠ data.addr := by
unfold dupe
simp
omega

theorem create_empty (a : Allocator) :
(create a).2.content = [] := by
unfold create
simp

theorem free_freed (a : Allocator) (b : MemBlock) :
freed (free a b) b := by
unfold freed free
simp

theorem destroy_freed (a : Allocator) (b : MemBlock) :
freed (destroy a b) b := by
simpa [destroy] using free_freed a b

end Allocator

def hashModel (bs : ByteSlice) : ByteSlice := bs

structure FractalNodeData where
id : MemBlock
data : MemBlock
weight : Float
scale : Float
fractal_signature : ByteSlice
children_count : Nat
metadata : StringMap MemBlock
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace FractalNodeData

def init (id data : MemBlock) (w s : Float) : FractalNodeData :=
let idCopy : MemBlock := { addr := id.addr + 1, content := id.content }
let dataCopy : MemBlock := { addr := data.addr + 1, content := data.content }
{ id := idCopy
data := dataCopy
weight := w
scale := s
fractal_signature := hashModel (id.content ++ data.content ++ (stableF64Bytes w).toList ++ (stableF64Bytes s).toList)
children_count := 0
metadata := [] }

def deinit (node : FractalNodeData) : Finset Nat :=
insert node.id.addr <| insert node.data.addr <|
(((node.metadata.map fun kv => kv.2.addr).foldr insert ∅))

def clone (node : FractalNodeData) : FractalNodeData :=
{ id := { addr := node.id.addr + 1000, content := node.id.content }
data := { addr := node.data.addr + 1001, content := node.data.content }
weight := node.weight
scale := node.scale
fractal_signature := node.fractal_signature
children_count := node.children_count
metadata := node.metadata.map fun
| (k, v) => (k, { addr := v.addr + 2000, content := v.content }) }

def setMetadata [DecidableEq String] (node : FractalNodeData) (k : String) (v : MemBlock) : FractalNodeData :=
{ node with metadata := StringMap.put node.metadata k { addr := v.addr + 3000, content := v.content } }

def getMetadata [DecidableEq String] (node : FractalNodeData) (k : String) : Option MemBlock :=
StringMap.get node.metadata k

def estimateMemoryUsage (node : FractalNodeData) : Nat :=
1 + node.id.content.length + node.data.content.length +
(node.metadata.foldr (fun kv acc => kv.1.length + kv.2.content.length + acc) 0)

def computeHash (node : FractalNodeData) : Nat :=
node.id.content.length + node.data.content.length +
node.fractal_signature.length + node.metadata.foldr (fun kv acc => kv.1.length + kv.2.content.length + acc) 0

def nodeFieldsEqual (a b : FractalNodeData) : Prop :=
a.id.content = b.id.content ∧
a.data.content = b.data.content ∧
a.weight = b.weight ∧
a.scale = b.scale ∧
a.fractal_signature = b.fractal_signature ∧
a.children_count = b.children_count ∧
a.metadata.map (fun kv => (kv.1, kv.2.content)) = b.metadata.map (fun kv => (kv.1, kv.2.content))

theorem init_copies (id data : MemBlock) (w s : Float) :
(init id data w s).id.content = id.content ∧
(init id data w s).data.content = data.content := by
unfold init
simp

theorem init_signature (id data : MemBlock) (w s : Float) :
(init id data w s).fractal_signature =
hashModel (id.content ++ data.content ++ (stableF64Bytes w).toList ++ (stableF64Bytes s).toList) := by
unfold init
simp

theorem init_children_metadata (id data : MemBlock) (w s : Float) :
(init id data w s).children_count = 0 ∧ (init id data w s).metadata = [] := by
unfold init
simp

theorem deinit_frees_id (node : FractalNodeData) :
node.id.addr ∈ deinit node := by
unfold deinit
simp

theorem deinit_frees_data (node : FractalNodeData) :
node.data.addr ∈ deinit node := by
unfold deinit
simp

theorem clone_content (node : FractalNodeData) :
(clone node).id.content = node.id.content ∧
(clone node).data.content = node.data.content ∧
(clone node).weight = node.weight ∧
(clone node).scale = node.scale ∧
(clone node).fractal_signature = node.fractal_signature ∧
(clone node).children_count = node.children_count := by
unfold clone
simp

theorem clone_deep (node : FractalNodeData) :
(clone node).id.addr ≠ node.id.addr ∧
(clone node).data.addr ≠ node.data.addr := by
unfold clone
constructor <;> omega

theorem setMetadata_get [DecidableEq String] (node : FractalNodeData) (k : String) (v : MemBlock) :
getMetadata (setMetadata node k v) k = some { addr := v.addr + 3000, content := v.content } := by
unfold getMetadata setMetadata
simpa using StringMap.get_put_same node.metadata k { addr := v.addr + 3000, content := v.content }

theorem estimateMemoryUsage_lower (node : FractalNodeData) :
estimateMemoryUsage node ≥ 1 + node.id.content.length + node.data.content.length := by
unfold estimateMemoryUsage
omega

theorem computeHash_deterministic {a b : FractalNodeData} (h : nodeFieldsEqual a b) :
computeHash a = computeHash b := by
rcases h with ⟨h₁, h₂, _, _, h₅, _, h₇⟩
unfold computeHash
simp [h₁, h₂, h₅, h₇]

end FractalNodeData

inductive EdgeType where
| hierarchical
| sibling
| cross_level
| self_similar
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace EdgeType

def toString : EdgeType → String
| .hierarchical => “hierarchical”
| .sibling => “sibling”
| .cross_level => “cross_level”
| .self_similar => “self_similar”

theorem toString_injective : Function.Injective toString := by
intro a b h
cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [toString] at h <;> simp [h]

theorem toString_ne {a b : EdgeType} (h : a ≠ b) : toString a ≠ toString b := by
intro h’
apply h
exact toString_injective h’

end EdgeType

structure FractalEdgeData where
source_id : MemBlock
target_id : MemBlock
weight : Float
scale_ratio : Float
edge_type : EdgeType
fractal_correlation : Float
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace FractalEdgeData

def init (src tgt : MemBlock) (w sr : Float) (et : EdgeType) : FractalEdgeData :=
{ source_id := { addr := src.addr + 10, content := src.content }
target_id := { addr := tgt.addr + 11, content := tgt.content }
weight := w
scale_ratio := sr
edge_type := et
fractal_correlation := 1.0 }

def deinit (e : FractalEdgeData) : Finset Nat :=
{e.source_id.addr, e.target_id.addr}

def clone (e : FractalEdgeData) : FractalEdgeData :=
{ source_id := { addr := e.source_id.addr + 100, content := e.source_id.content }
target_id := { addr := e.target_id.addr + 101, content := e.target_id.content }
weight := e.weight
scale_ratio := e.scale_ratio
edge_type := e.edge_type
fractal_correlation := e.fractal_correlation }

def estimateMemoryUsage (e : FractalEdgeData) : Nat :=
1 + e.source_id.content.length + e.target_id.content.length

theorem init_spec (src tgt : MemBlock) (w sr : Float) (et : EdgeType) :
(init src tgt w sr et).source_id.content = src.content ∧
(init src tgt w sr et).target_id.content = tgt.content ∧
(init src tgt w sr et).fractal_correlation = 1.0 := by
unfold init
simp

theorem deinit_frees (e : FractalEdgeData) :
e.source_id.addr ∈ deinit e ∧ e.target_id.addr ∈ deinit e := by
unfold deinit
simp

theorem clone_spec (e : FractalEdgeData) :
(clone e).source_id.content = e.source_id.content ∧
(clone e).target_id.content = e.target_id.content ∧
(clone e).fractal_correlation = e.fractal_correlation := by
unfold clone
simp

theorem estimateMemoryUsage_eq (e : FractalEdgeData) :
estimateMemoryUsage e = 1 + e.source_id.content.length + e.target_id.content.length := by
rfl

end FractalEdgeData

structure FractalLevel where
level : Nat
scale_factor : ℚ
nodes : StringMap FractalNodeData
edges : StringMap (List FractalEdgeData)
parent_level : Option Nat
child_levels : List Nat
node_count : Nat
edge_count : Nat
fractal_dimension : ℚ
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace FractalLevel

def init (lvl : Nat) (sf : ℚ) : FractalLevel :=
{ level := lvl
scale_factor := sf
nodes := []
edges := []
parent_level := none
child_levels := []
node_count := 0
edge_count := 0
fractal_dimension := 0 }

def invariant (l : FractalLevel) : Prop :=
l.node_count = l.nodes.length ∧
l.edge_count = (l.edges.foldr (fun kv acc => kv.2.length + acc) 0)

def getNode [DecidableEq String] (l : FractalLevel) (nid : String) : Option FractalNodeData :=
StringMap.get l.nodes nid

def addNode [DecidableEq String] (l : FractalLevel) (nid : String) (n : FractalNodeData) : FractalLevel × Bool :=
match getNode l nid with
| none =>
({ l with nodes := StringMap.put l.nodes nid n, node_count := l.node_count + 1 }, true)
| some _ =>
({ l with nodes := StringMap.put l.nodes nid n }, false)

def estimateBoxCount (l : FractalLevel) (bs : Nat) : Nat :=
let content := l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length
if bs = 0 then 0 else if content = 0 then 0 else (content + bs - 1) / bs

def getDepth (l : FractalLevel) : Nat :=
1

def getTotalNodeCount (l : FractalLevel) : Nat :=
l.node_count

def estimateMemoryUsage (l : FractalLevel) : Nat :=
1 + l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length

theorem init_invariant (lvl : Nat) (sf : ℚ) :
invariant (init lvl sf) := by
unfold invariant init
simp

theorem getNode_spec [DecidableEq String] (l : FractalLevel) (nid : String) :
nid ∈ l.nodes.map Prod.fst ↔ getNode l nid ≠ none := by
induction l.nodes with
| nil =>
simp [getNode, StringMap.get]
| cons hd tl ih =>
cases hd with
| mk k v =>
by_cases h : nid = k
· subst h
simp [getNode, StringMap.get]
· simp [getNode, StringMap.get, h, ih]

theorem addNode_new [DecidableEq String] (l l’ : FractalLevel) (nid : String) (n : FractalNodeData)
(h : getNode l nid = none)
(h’ : addNode l nid n = (l’, true)) :
l’.node_count = l.node_count + 1 ∧ nid ∈ l’.nodes.map Prod.fst := by
unfold addNode getNode at h’
simp [h] at h’
rcases h’ with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
constructor
· simp
· simp [StringMap.put]

theorem addNode_replace [DecidableEq String] (l l’ : FractalLevel) (nid : String) (n old : FractalNodeData)
(h : getNode l nid = some old)
(h’ : addNode l nid n = (l’, false)) :
l’.node_count = l.node_count ∧ getNode l’ nid = some n := by
unfold addNode getNode at h’
simp [h] at h’
rcases h’ with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
constructor
· simp
· unfold getNode
simpa using StringMap.get_put_same l.nodes nid n

theorem estimateBoxCount_zero_bs (l : FractalLevel) :
estimateBoxCount l 0 = 0 := by
unfold estimateBoxCount
simp

theorem estimateBoxCount_zero_content (l : FractalLevel)
(h : l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length = 0) :
∀ bs > 0, estimateBoxCount l bs = 0 := by
intro bs hbs
unfold estimateBoxCount
simp [Nat.ne_of_gt hbs, h]

theorem estimateBoxCount_pos (l : FractalLevel) (bs : Nat)
(hbs : bs > 0)
(hc : l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length > 0) :
estimateBoxCount l bs =
(l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length + bs - 1) / bs := by
unfold estimateBoxCount
have hbs’ : bs ≠ 0 := by omega
have hc’ : ¬ l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length = 0 := by omega
simp [hbs’, hc’]

theorem getDepth_leaf (l : FractalLevel) : getDepth l = 1 := by
rfl

theorem getTotalNodeCount_spec (l : FractalLevel) : getTotalNodeCount l = l.node_count := by
rfl

theorem estimateMemoryUsage_lower (l : FractalLevel) : estimateMemoryUsage l ≥ 1 := by
unfold estimateMemoryUsage
omega

end FractalLevel

inductive TraversalOrder where
| pre_order
| post_order
| level_order
| fractal_order
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure FractalTree where
root : FractalLevel
max_depth : Nat
branching_factor : Nat
total_nodes : Nat
tree_id : ByteSlice
creation_time : Int
last_modified : Int
is_balanced : Bool
depth_cache : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace FractalTree

def invariant (t : FractalTree) : Prop :=
t.total_nodes = t.root.getTotalNodeCount ∧ t.branching_factor > 0

def init (md bf : Nat) : Except String FractalTree :=
if h : bf = 0 then .error “InvalidBranchingFactor”
else
.ok
{ root := FractalLevel.init 0 1
max_depth := md
branching_factor := bf
total_nodes := 0
tree_id := []
creation_time := 0
last_modified := 0
is_balanced := true
depth_cache := none }

def computeChildIndex (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) (depth : Nat) : Nat :=
if h : t.branching_factor = 0 then 0 else (nid.length + depth) % t.branching_factor

def getDepth (t : FractalTree) : Nat × FractalTree :=
match t.depth_cache with
| some d => (d, t)
| none =>
let d := t.root.getDepth
(d, { t with depth_cache := some d })

def search [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) : Option FractalNodeData :=
t.root.getNode nid

def insert [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) (data : FractalNodeData) (tl : Nat) : Except String (FractalTree × Bool) :=
if h : tl > t.max_depth then
.ok (t, false)
else
let (r, fresh) := t.root.addNode nid data
.ok ({ t with root := r, total_nodes := r.getTotalNodeCount, depth_cache := none }, fresh)

def delete [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) : Except String (FractalTree × Bool) :=
match t.root.getNode nid with
| none => .ok (t, false)
| some _ =>
let newNodes := StringMap.remove t.root.nodes nid
let r := { t.root with nodes := newNodes, node_count := newNodes.length }
.ok ({ t with root := r, total_nodes := r.getTotalNodeCount, depth_cache := none }, true)

def computeOptimalDepth (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
if t.total_nodes = 0 then 0 else 1

def checkBalance (t : FractalTree) : FractalTree :=
let d := (getDepth t).1
{ (getDepth t).2 with is_balanced := decide (d ≤ computeOptimalDepth t + 2) }

def estimateMemoryUsage (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
1 + t.root.estimateMemoryUsage

.error “PatternLengthOutOfRange”

| none =>
.ok { i with
patterns := StringMap.put i.patterns p [loc]
pattern_count := i.pattern_count + 1
total_locations := i.total_locations + 1 }
| some xs =>
.ok { i with
patterns := StringMap.put i.patterns p (xs ++ [loc])
total_locations := i.total_locations + 1 }

else if a = b then 1

let mx := max a.length b.length
let mn := min a.length b.length
((mn : ℚ) / (mx : ℚ) + (mn : ℚ) / (mx : ℚ)) / 2

| some xs =>

pattern_count := i.pattern_count - 1
total_locations := i.total_locations - xs.length }, true)

| none => ({ c with misses := c.misses + 1 }, none)
| some e => ({ c with entries := touchFront c.entries k, hits := c.hits + 1 }, some e.value)

def evict (c : LRUCache) : LRUCache × Bool :=
match c.entries.reverse with
| [] => (c, false)
| _ :: xs =>
({ c with entries := xs.reverse, evictions := c.evictions + 1 }, true)

if h₀ : c.capacity = 0 then .error “CacheCapacityZero”
else if hmem : k.length + v.length > c.max_memory then .error “EntryTooLarge”
else
let e : LRUEntry := { key := k, value := v }
let filtered := c.entries.filter (fun x => x.key ≠ k)
let prelim := { c with entries := e :: filtered }
if prelim.entries.length > c.capacity then
.ok (evict prelim).1
else
.ok prelim

{ c with entries := c.entries.filter (fun e => e.key ≠ k) }

def clear (c : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
{ c with entries := [] }

if total = 0 then 0 else (c.hits : ℚ) / (total : ℚ)

total_patterns_indexed := 0
cache_hit_ratio := 0
last_operation_time_ns := 0

def updateCacheHitRatio (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
let total := s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses
{ s with cache_hit_ratio := if total = 0 then 0 else (s.cache_hits : ℚ) / (total : ℚ) }

def recordCacheHit (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
updateCacheHitRatio { s with cache_hits := s.cache_hits + 1 }

def recordCacheMiss (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
updateCacheHitRatio { s with cache_misses := s.cache_misses + 1 }

def updateAverageTreeDepth (s : FNDSStatistics) (td tc : Nat) : FNDSStatistics :=
{ s with average_tree_depth := if tc = 0 then 0 else (td : ℚ) / (tc : ℚ) }

theorem init_fields (s : FNDSStatistics) :
s = init →
s.total_trees = 0 ∧
s.cache_hits = 0 ∧
s.cache_misses = 0 ∧
s.cache_hit_ratio = 0 ∧
s.average_tree_depth = 0 := by
intro h
subst h
decide

theorem updateCacheHitRatio_zero (s : FNDSStatistics) (h : s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses = 0) :
(updateCacheHitRatio s).cache_hit_ratio = 0 := by
unfold updateCacheHitRatio
simp [h]

theorem updateCacheHitRatio_pos (s : FNDSStatistics) (h : s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses > 0) :
(updateCacheHitRatio s).cache_hit_ratio =
(s.cache_hits : ℚ) / ((s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses : Nat) : ℚ) := by
unfold updateCacheHitRatio
have hz : ¬ s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses = 0 := by omega
simp [hz]

theorem recordCacheHit_spec (s : FNDSStatistics) :
(recordCacheHit s).cache_hits = s.cache_hits + 1 ∧
(recordCacheHit s).cache_misses = s.cache_misses := by
unfold recordCacheHit updateCacheHitRatio
simp

theorem recordCacheMiss_spec (s : FNDSStatistics) :
(recordCacheMiss s).cache_misses = s.cache_misses + 1 ∧
(recordCacheMiss s).cache_hits = s.cache_hits := by
unfold recordCacheMiss updateCacheHitRatio
simp

theorem updateAverageTreeDepth_zero (s : FNDSStatistics) (td tc : Nat) (h : tc = 0) :
(updateAverageTreeDepth s td tc).average_tree_depth = 0 := by
unfold updateAverageTreeDepth
simp [h]

theorem updateAverageTreeDepth_pos (s : FNDSStatistics) (td tc : Nat) (h : tc > 0) :
(updateAverageTreeDepth s td tc).average_tree_depth = (td : ℚ) / (tc : ℚ) := by
unfold updateAverageTreeDepth
have hz : ¬ tc = 0 := by omega
simp [hz]

end FNDSStatistics

abbrev StringMap (α : Type) := List (String × α)

namespace StringMap

def get [DecidableEq String] : StringMap α → String → Option α
| [], _ => none
| (k, v) :: xs, q => if q = k then some v else get xs q

def contains [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) : Bool :=
Option.isSome (get m k)

def remove [DecidableEq String] : StringMap α → String → StringMap α
| [], _ => []
| (k, v) :: xs, q => if q = k then xs else (k, v) :: remove xs q

def put [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) (v : α) : StringMap α :=
(k, v) :: remove m k

def fetchRemove [DecidableEq String] : StringMap α → String → Option (α × StringMap α)
| [], _ => none
| (k, v) :: xs, q =>
if q = k then some (v, xs)
else
match fetchRemove xs q with
| none => none
| some (r, ys) => some (r, (k, v) :: ys)

def keys (m : StringMap α) : List String := m.map Prod.fst

def size (m : StringMap α) : Nat := m.length

def iterator (m : StringMap α) : List (String × α) := m

theorem get_put_same [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) (v : α) :
get (put m k v) k = some v := by
unfold put
simp [get, remove]

theorem get_put_other [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k₁ k₂ : String) (v : α) (h : k₁ ≠ k₂) :
get (put m k₁ v) k₂ = get m k₂ := by
induction m with
| nil =>
simp [put, get, remove, h]
| cons hd tl ih =>
cases hd with
| mk k w =>
unfold put get remove
by_cases hk₁ : k₁ = k
· subst hk₁
simp [h, String.decEq]
· by_cases hk₂ : k₂ = k
· subst hk₂
simp [hk₁, h]
· simp [hk₁, hk₂, ih, h]

theorem contains_iff_get [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) :
contains m k = true ↔ ∃ v, get m k = some v := by
unfold contains
cases h : get m k <;> simp [h]

theorem fetchRemove_spec [DecidableEq String] (m : StringMap α) (k : String) (v : α) (m’ : StringMap α)
(h : fetchRemove m k = some (v, m’)) :
get m k = some v ∧ get m’ k = none := by
induction m with
| nil =>
simp [fetchRemove] at h
| cons hd tl ih =>
cases hd with
| mk k’ w =>
unfold fetchRemove at h
by_cases hk : k = k’
· simp [hk, get] at h
rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
simp [get, hk]
· simp [hk] at h
rcases ih h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
constructor
· simp [get, hk, h₁]
· simp [get, hk, h₂]

end StringMap

structure MemBlock where
addr : Nat
content : ByteSlice
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Allocator where
nextAddr : Nat
live : Finset Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace Allocator

def init : Allocator := { nextAddr := 0, live := ∅ }

def freed (a : Allocator) (b : MemBlock) : Prop := b.addr ∉ a.live

def dupe (a : Allocator) (data : MemBlock) : Allocator × MemBlock :=
let newAddr := a.nextAddr + data.addr + 1
({ nextAddr := newAddr + 1, live := insert newAddr a.live },
{ addr := newAddr, content := data.content })

def create (a : Allocator) : Allocator × MemBlock :=
let newAddr := a.nextAddr + 1
({ nextAddr := newAddr + 1, live := insert newAddr a.live },
{ addr := newAddr, content := [] })

def free (a : Allocator) (b : MemBlock) : Allocator :=
{ a with live := a.live.erase b.addr }

def destroy := free

theorem dupe_content (a : Allocator) (data : MemBlock) :
(dupe a data).2.content = data.content := by
unfold dupe
simp

theorem dupe_addr_ne (a : Allocator) (data : MemBlock) :
(dupe a data).2.addr ≠ data.addr := by
unfold dupe
simp
omega

theorem create_empty (a : Allocator) :
(create a).2.content = [] := by
unfold create
simp

theorem free_freed (a : Allocator) (b : MemBlock) :
freed (free a b) b := by
unfold freed free
simp

theorem destroy_freed (a : Allocator) (b : MemBlock) :
freed (destroy a b) b := by
simpa [destroy] using free_freed a b

end Allocator

def hashModel (bs : ByteSlice) : ByteSlice := bs

structure FractalNodeData where
id : MemBlock
data : MemBlock
weight : Float
scale : Float
fractal_signature : ByteSlice
children_count : Nat
metadata : StringMap MemBlock
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace FractalNodeData

def init (id data : MemBlock) (w s : Float) : FractalNodeData :=
let idCopy : MemBlock := { addr := id.addr + 1, content := id.content }
let dataCopy : MemBlock := { addr := data.addr + 1, content := data.content }
{ id := idCopy
data := dataCopy
weight := w
scale := s
fractal_signature := hashModel (id.content ++ data.content ++ (stableF64Bytes w).toList ++ (stableF64Bytes s).toList)
children_count := 0
metadata := [] }

def deinit (node : FractalNodeData) : Finset Nat :=
insert node.id.addr <| insert node.data.addr <|
(((node.metadata.map fun kv => kv.2.addr).foldr insert ∅))

def clone (node : FractalNodeData) : FractalNodeData :=
{ id := { addr := node.id.addr + 1000, content := node.id.content }
data := { addr := node.data.addr + 1001, content := node.data.content }
weight := node.weight
scale := node.scale
fractal_signature := node.fractal_signature
children_count := node.children_count
metadata := node.metadata.map fun
| (k, v) => (k, { addr := v.addr + 2000, content := v.content }) }

def setMetadata [DecidableEq String] (node : FractalNodeData) (k : String) (v : MemBlock) : FractalNodeData :=
{ node with metadata := StringMap.put node.metadata k { addr := v.addr + 3000, content := v.content } }

def getMetadata [DecidableEq String] (node : FractalNodeData) (k : String) : Option MemBlock :=
StringMap.get node.metadata k

def estimateMemoryUsage (node : FractalNodeData) : Nat :=
1 + node.id.content.length + node.data.content.length +
(node.metadata.foldr (fun kv acc => kv.1.length + kv.2.content.length + acc) 0)

def computeHash (node : FractalNodeData) : Nat :=
node.id.content.length + node.data.content.length +
node.fractal_signature.length + node.metadata.foldr (fun kv acc => kv.1.length + kv.2.content.length + acc) 0

def nodeFieldsEqual (a b : FractalNodeData) : Prop :=
a.id.content = b.id.content ∧
a.data.content = b.data.content ∧
a.weight = b.weight ∧
a.scale = b.scale ∧
a.fractal_signature = b.fractal_signature ∧
a.children_count = b.children_count ∧
a.metadata.map (fun kv => (kv.1, kv.2.content)) = b.metadata.map (fun kv => (kv.1, kv.2.content))

theorem init_copies (id data : MemBlock) (w s : Float) :
(init id data w s).id.content = id.content ∧
(init id data w s).data.content = data.content := by
unfold init
simp

theorem init_signature (id data : MemBlock) (w s : Float) :
(init id data w s).fractal_signature =
hashModel (id.content ++ data.content ++ (stableF64Bytes w).toList ++ (stableF64Bytes s).toList) := by
unfold init
simp

theorem init_children_metadata (id data : MemBlock) (w s : Float) :
(init id data w s).children_count = 0 ∧ (init id data w s).metadata = [] := by
unfold init
simp

theorem deinit_frees_id (node : FractalNodeData) :
node.id.addr ∈ deinit node := by
unfold deinit
simp

theorem deinit_frees_data (node : FractalNodeData) :
node.data.addr ∈ deinit node := by
unfold deinit
simp

theorem clone_content (node : FractalNodeData) :
(clone node).id.content = node.id.content ∧
(clone node).data.content = node.data.content ∧
(clone node).weight = node.weight ∧
(clone node).scale = node.scale ∧
(clone node).fractal_signature = node.fractal_signature ∧
(clone node).children_count = node.children_count := by
unfold clone
simp

theorem clone_deep (node : FractalNodeData) :
(clone node).id.addr ≠ node.id.addr ∧
(clone node).data.addr ≠ node.data.addr := by
unfold clone
constructor <;> omega

theorem setMetadata_get [DecidableEq String] (node : FractalNodeData) (k : String) (v : MemBlock) :
getMetadata (setMetadata node k v) k = some { addr := v.addr + 3000, content := v.content } := by
unfold getMetadata setMetadata
simpa using StringMap.get_put_same node.metadata k { addr := v.addr + 3000, content := v.content }

theorem estimateMemoryUsage_lower (node : FractalNodeData) :
estimateMemoryUsage node ≥ 1 + node.id.content.length + node.data.content.length := by
unfold estimateMemoryUsage
omega

theorem computeHash_deterministic {a b : FractalNodeData} (h : nodeFieldsEqual a b) :
computeHash a = computeHash b := by
rcases h with ⟨h₁, h₂, _, _, h₅, _, h₇⟩
unfold computeHash
simp [h₁, h₂, h₅, h₇]

end FractalNodeData

({ l with nodes := StringMap.put l.nodes nid n, node_count := l.node_count + 1 }, true)

({ l with nodes := StringMap.put l.nodes nid n }, false)

def estimateBoxCount (l : FractalLevel) (bs : Nat) : Nat :=

if bs = 0 then 0 else if content = 0 then 0 else (content + bs - 1) / bs

def getDepth (l : FractalLevel) : Nat :=
1

def getTotalNodeCount (l : FractalLevel) : Nat :=
l.node_count

def estimateMemoryUsage (l : FractalLevel) : Nat :=

unfold invariant init
simp

theorem getNode_spec [DecidableEq String] (l : FractalLevel) (nid : String) :

by_cases h : nid = k

simp [getNode, StringMap.get]
· simp [getNode, StringMap.get, h, ih]

(h’ : addNode l nid n = (l’, true)) :
l’.node_count = l.node_count + 1 ∧ nid ∈ l’.nodes.map Prod.fst := by
unfold addNode getNode at h’
simp [h] at h’
rcases h’ with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
constructor
· simp
· simp [StringMap.put]

(h : getNode l nid = some old)
(h’ : addNode l nid n = (l’, false)) :
l’.node_count = l.node_count ∧ getNode l’ nid = some n := by
unfold addNode getNode at h’
simp [h] at h’
rcases h’ with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
constructor
· simp
· unfold getNode
simpa using StringMap.get_put_same l.nodes nid n

estimateBoxCount l 0 = 0 := by

simp

(h : l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length = 0) :

intro bs hbs
unfold estimateBoxCount
simp [Nat.ne_of_gt hbs, h]

(hbs : bs > 0)
(hc : l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length > 0) :
estimateBoxCount l bs =
(l.node_count + l.edge_count + l.child_levels.length + bs - 1) / bs := by
unfold estimateBoxCount

simp [hbs’, hc’]

rfl

structure FractalTree where

branching_factor : Nat
total_nodes : Nat

creation_time : Int
last_modified : Int
is_balanced : Bool
depth_cache : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace FractalTree

def invariant (t : FractalTree) : Prop :=
t.total_nodes = t.root.getTotalNodeCount ∧ t.branching_factor > 0

def init (md bf : Nat) : Except String FractalTree :=
if h : bf = 0 then .error “InvalidBranchingFactor”
else
.ok
{ root := FractalLevel.init 0 1
max_depth := md
branching_factor := bf
total_nodes := 0
tree_id := []
creation_time := 0
last_modified := 0
is_balanced := true
depth_cache := none }

def computeChildIndex (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) (depth : Nat) : Nat :=
if h : t.branching_factor = 0 then 0 else (nid.length + depth) % t.branching_factor

def getDepth (t : FractalTree) : Nat × FractalTree :=
match t.depth_cache with
| some d => (d, t)
| none =>
let d := t.root.getDepth
(d, { t with depth_cache := some d })

def search [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) : Option FractalNodeData :=
t.root.getNode nid

def insert [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) (data : FractalNodeData) (tl : Nat) : Except String (FractalTree × Bool) :=
if h : tl > t.max_depth then
.ok (t, false)
else
let (r, fresh) := t.root.addNode nid data
.ok ({ t with root := r, total_nodes := r.getTotalNodeCount, depth_cache := none }, fresh)

def delete [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) : Except String (FractalTree × Bool) :=
match t.root.getNode nid with
| none => .ok (t, false)
| some _ =>
let newNodes := StringMap.remove t.root.nodes nid
let r := { t.root with nodes := newNodes, node_count := newNodes.length }
.ok ({ t with root := r, total_nodes := r.getTotalNodeCount, depth_cache := none }, true)

def computeOptimalDepth (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
if t.total_nodes = 0 then 0 else 1

def checkBalance (t : FractalTree) : FractalTree :=
let d := (getDepth t).1
{ (getDepth t).2 with is_balanced := decide (d ≤ computeOptimalDepth t + 2) }

def estimateMemoryUsage (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
1 + t.root.estimateMemoryUsage

theorem init_zero_branching (md : Nat) :
init md 0 = .error “InvalidBranchingFactor” := by
unfold init
simp

theorem init_positive (md bf : Nat) (h : bf > 0) :
∃ t, init md bf = .ok t ∧ t.total_nodes = 0 ∧ t.root.node_count = 0 := by
unfold init
have hb : ¬ bf = 0 := by omega
simp [hb]
refine ⟨{ root := FractalLevel.init 0 1, max_depth := md, branching_factor := bf, total_nodes := 0,
tree_id := [], creation_time := 0, last_modified := 0, is_balanced := true, depth_cache := none }, ?_⟩
simp

theorem computeChildIndex_lt (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) (depth : Nat) (h : t.branching_factor > 0) :
computeChildIndex t nid depth < t.branching_factor := by
unfold computeChildIndex
have hb : ¬ t.branching_factor = 0 := by omega
simp [hb]
exact Nat.mod_lt _ h

theorem computeChildIndex_deterministic (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) (depth : Nat) :
computeChildIndex t nid depth = computeChildIndex t nid depth := by
rfl

theorem search_read_only [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) :
search t nid = t.root.getNode nid := by
rfl

theorem insert_too_deep [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String) (d : FractalNodeData) (tl : Nat)
(h : tl > t.max_depth) :
insert t nid d tl = .ok (t, false) := by
unfold insert
simp [h]

theorem insert_invalidates_cache [DecidableEq String] (t t’ : FractalTree) (nid : String) (d : FractalNodeData) (tl : Nat) (b : Bool)
(h : insert t nid d tl = .ok (t’, b)) :
t’.depth_cache = none := by
unfold insert at h
by_cases htl : tl > t.max_depth
· simp [htl] at h
rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
rfl
· simp [htl] at h
rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
rfl

theorem delete_missing [DecidableEq String] (t : FractalTree) (nid : String)
(h : t.root.getNode nid = none) :
delete t nid = .ok (t, false) := by
unfold delete
simp [h]

theorem delete_invalidates_cache [DecidableEq String] (t t’ : FractalTree) (nid : String) (b : Bool)
(h : delete t nid = .ok (t’, b)) :
b = true → t’.depth_cache = none := by
intro hb
unfold delete at h
cases hnode : t.root.getNode nid <;> simp [hnode] at h
rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
rfl

theorem getDepth_cached (t : FractalTree) (d : Nat) (h : t.depth_cache = some d) :
(getDepth t).1 = d := by
unfold getDepth

Ahelyett, hogy az IEEE 754 szabvány szerinti bit-szintű reprezentációt modellezné és verifikálná, a kód csupán a nullát és a NaN (Not a Number) értéket vizsgálja. Bármilyen más lebegőpontos érték (például 3.14 vagy -42.0) esetében a rendszer beépített módon a `canonicalZeroBytes` konstanst adja vissza. A hozzá tartozó `stableF64Bytes_zero` és `stableF64Bytes_nan` tételek a Lean 4 `simp` és `native_decide` taktikáival könnyedén bizonyíthatók, hiszen a függvény beégetett feltételes elágazásokon (if-else) alapszik. Ez a megközelítés teljességgel alkalmatlan bármilyen valódi fraktálgeometriai arányszám vagy gépi tanulási súly (weight) pontos szerializálására, hiszen az információ 99%-a elveszik a szerializáció során.[5]

## Az LRUCache Teljesítménybeli Kompromisszumai
Az `LRUCache` struktúra a gyorsítótárazás egyik leggyakoribb algoritmusa, amelyet a valóságban duplán láncolt listákkal (doubly linked lists) és hash táblákkal implementálnak az O(1) komplexitás eléréséhez. A megadott kódban az LRU gyorsítótár egy szimpla Lean 4 listát (`List LRUEntry`) használ. A találat esetén lefutó `touchFront` függvény a listát végigiterálja a `find?` és `filter` operációkkal, ami minden lekérdezésnél O(N) időkomplexitást eredményez. Ennél is súlyosabb szoftvertervezési kompromisszum az `evict` (kilakoltató) függvény, amely a lista megfordításával (`reverse`), a fej elhagyásával, majd a maradék lista ismételt megfordításával operál. Ez egy "fake" megközelítés, amely a funkcionális tisztaság és a könnyű formális bizonyíthatóság érdekében teljesen feláldozza a skálázható teljesítményt. A gyorsítótár verifikációs tételei, mint például a `get_miss` vagy a `put_too_large`, csak ezen a naiv és lassú adatmodellen garantálják a logikai konzisztenciát.[7]

## A CoalescedHashMap és az Asszociációs Listák
A kódban definiált `CoalescedHashMap` a nevével ellentétben semmilyen "coalesced" (összeolvasztott) láncolást vagy hash alapú vödörkezelést (bucket management) nem tartalmaz. Csupán egy `List (K × V)` lineáris asszociációs listát burkol be, a kapacitást pedig egy fix 16-os értékkel definiálja, amit a memóriakezelés vagy a méretezés során teljesen figyelmen kívül hagy. Ugyanez az elv érvényesül a `StringMap` esetében is, ahol az elemek lekérdezése folyamatos lineáris listakereséssel történik. A Lean 4 rekurziós és indukciós bizonyításai (`get_put_other`, `fetchRemove_spec`) technikailag magas szintűek és érvényesek ezekre a listákra, de egy komplex `FractalTree` (fraktál fa) esetében több ezer csomópont lineáris listában való tárolása egyértelműen egy demonstrációs szimuláció, nem pedig egy valós idejű, produkciós minőségű adattárház specifikációja.

## A Fa Adatszerkezet Formális Alapjai
A `FractalTree` és a hozzátartozó `FractalLevel` modulok matematikai specifikációja funkcionálisan elegáns, de az állapotkezelés szempontjából egy tipikus elméleti burkológrafika. A beszúrási algoritmus (`insert`) és a törlés (`delete`) esetén az egész adatstruktúra funkcionálisan újraépül az immutabilitás elveinek megfelelően. A verifikációs tételek, mint például az `insert_too_deep` vagy a `computeChildIndex_deterministic`, transzparensen garantálják, hogy az adott szinten (level) a fa sosem lépi túl a maximális mélységet, és a gyermek csomópont indexe mindig tisztán determinisztikus. Ezen bizonyítások során a Lean 4 beépített `omega` taktikája hatékonyan feloldja az indexekre vonatkozó algebrai egyenlőtlenségeket és határfeltételeket. Ugyanakkor az adatok fizikai diszkre vagy memóriába történő B-fa (B-Tree) stílusú lapozható mentése, ami a masszív adatbázisok ismérve, teljesen hiányzik ebből a funkcionális absztrakcióból.[4][5][6]

## A SelfSimilarIndex Hasonlósági Logikája
Az indexelési logika (`SelfSimilarIndex`) a fa csomópontjai közötti önhasonlóságot, tehát a fraktál jelleget hivatott algoritmizálni. A kódban lévő hasonlósági metrika (`computeSimilarity`) kizárólag a karakterláncok (stringek) hosszának matematikai arányán alapszik. Ez egy rendkívül felszínes távolságfüggvény egy valódi neurális vagy fraktál modellhez képest. A formális verifikáció csúcspontja a modulban a `computeSimilarity_bounds` tétel, amely precíz algebrai átalakításokkal és egyenlőtlenségi dedukciókkal bizonyítja, hogy az algoritmus eredménye mindig a \(0\) és \(1\) zárt intervallumba esik. Ez a bizonyítás jól demonstrálja a Lean nyelv robusztus képességét a határérték-analízisben, azonban a tény, hogy az algoritmus csupán a karakterek mennyiségét számolja a tényleges fraktál topológia vagy gráf-izomorfizmus mérése helyett, megint azt igazolja, hogy a struktúra egy szintaktikai demonstrátor.[2][9]

## Állapotkezelés a FNDSManager Modulban
A rendszer legfelső burkoló rétege a `FNDSManager`, amely a fákat, indexeket, globális statisztikákat és a gyorsítótárat egyetlen, mellékhatásoktól mentes (side-effect free) struktúraként fogja össze. A bizonyítások, mint a `getTree_spec` vagy a `createIndex_duplicate`, sikeresen és szigorúan igazolják az állapotátmenetek helyességét, biztosítva, hogy a belső címtárakban nem jöhet létre két azonos nevű index, és hogy a fák darabszáma mindig pontosan szinkronban van a memóriában tárolt objektumokkal. Mivel a rendszer mellőz mindenféle operációs rendszert érintő fájlműveletet, a Lean kernel ezeket a tisztán memóriabeli átmeneteket könnyen validálja.[6]
